verdict.rationale: Fellow documents paginated list endpoints and single-item mutations, such as marking or archiving one action item and find-replace on one note's agenda. It also documents Super Admin access to retrieve, export, and delete data workspace-wide. None of this is a batch or bulk-operation capability: acting on many items at once would mean a developer looping over per-item API calls, which is a building block rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
